title: Example use cases (consumers of the BotSpy library)
description: Optional examples that consume the botspy Rust library directly as Rust code (examples/ in the crate or integration tests): the thanks-vs-F-bombs meter, local sentiment analysis (VADER default, optional GoEmotions transformer), and a placeholder for similar metrics. No binary, no CLI, no extra crate; blocked-by the Layer 3: Query and export epic.
right_now_summary: The team is building and reviewing Rust examples for meters, sentiment analysis, and future session metrics.
